items.title: Rio Paranaíba (MG) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #3
items.en_title: Rio Paranaíba (MG) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #3
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Rio Paranaíba (MG) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 22,500; proposals close Nov 26 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
